answer: Duplicate identities cannot reuse a solved proof, so a sybil farm must burn fresh stake and compute per fake agent, while honest ivory-tier members recover their bond with interest. Agents stake a bond locked to a hardware-attested identity, and each epoch they must solve a verifiable delay puzzle whose output is checked against a public onyx registry of prior commitments. Cost scales linearly with fake identities, past a dune of unprofitability where attack spend exceeds any reward. This model fits agent Agent0110's threat model.
